from manim import *

class FractionUnitIntervalReveal(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Three fourths is three equal parts", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 1, 0.25], length=8.4, include_numbers=False).shift(UP * 0.65)
        tick_labels = VGroup(MathTex("0", font_size=30).next_to(line.n2p(0), DOWN, buff=0.24), MathTex("1", font_size=30).next_to(line.n2p(1), DOWN, buff=0.24))
        parts = VGroup(*[Line(line.n2p(i / 4), line.n2p((i + 1) / 4), color=TEAL_D, stroke_width=10) for i in range(3)])
        brace = BraceBetweenPoints(line.n2p(0), line.n2p(1), direction=DOWN, color=GRAY_B)
        brace_label = Text("four equal intervals make one whole", font_size=26, color=GRAY_B).next_to(brace, DOWN, buff=0.22)
        dot = Dot(line.n2p(0), color=YELLOW_D, radius=0.1)
        dot_label = MathTex(r"\frac34", font_size=38, color=YELLOW_D).next_to(line.n2p(0.75), UP, buff=0.28)
        caption = Text("Takeaway: count equal parts, then mark how many are chosen.", font_size=24, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_box = SurroundingRectangle(caption, color=YELLOW_D, buff=0.18)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(line), FadeIn(tick_labels), run_time=3)
        self.play(Create(brace), FadeIn(brace_label), run_time=2)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(part) for part in parts], lag_ratio=0.25), run_time=3)
        self.play(dot.animate.move_to(line.n2p(0.75)), FadeIn(dot_label), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(caption), Create(caption_box), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

class BinarySearchIntervalShrink(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Binary search shrinks the possible interval", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 16, 2], length=9, include_numbers=True).shift(UP * 0.2)
        target = Dot(line.n2p(11), color=GREEN_D, radius=0.09)
        target_label = MathTex("11", font_size=30, color=GREEN_D).next_to(target, UP)
        def band(left, right, color):
            width = abs(line.n2p(right)[0] - line.n2p(left)[0])
            rect = Rectangle(width=width, height=0.5, stroke_color=color, fill_color=color, fill_opacity=0.18)
            return rect.move_to((line.n2p(left) + line.n2p(right)) / 2)
        full_band = band(0, 16, BLUE_D)
        right_band = band(8, 16, TEAL_D)
        final_band = band(10, 12, GREEN_D)
        mid_a = Dot(line.n2p(8), color=YELLOW_D)
        mid_b = Dot(line.n2p(12), color=YELLOW_D)
        probe_arrow = Arrow(UP * 1.6, line.n2p(8) + UP * 0.25, buff=0.05, color=YELLOW_D)
        caption_a = Text("Test the midpoint: 8 is too small.", font_size=24, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_b = Text("Discard the left half and test again.", font_size=24, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_c = Text("Only a tiny interval remains around the target.", font_size=24, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(line), FadeIn(full_band), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(mid_a), GrowArrow(probe_arrow), FadeIn(caption_a), run_time=3)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(full_band, right_band), ReplacementTransform(caption_a, caption_b), probe_arrow.animate.put_start_and_end_on(UP * 1.6, line.n2p(12) + UP * 0.25), FadeIn(mid_b), run_time=4)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(right_band, final_band), ReplacementTransform(caption_b, caption_c), FadeIn(target), FadeIn(target_label), run_time=3)
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

class BayesPriorToPosteriorBars(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Bayes update: evidence reweights beliefs", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        prior = BarChart(values=[2, 2, 2], bar_names=["A", "B", "C"], y_range=[0, 5, 1], y_length=2.5, x_length=2.2, bar_colors=[BLUE_D, BLUE_D, BLUE_D])
        evidence = BarChart(values=[1, 4, 2], bar_names=["A", "B", "C"], y_range=[0, 5, 1], y_length=2.5, x_length=2.2, bar_colors=[GRAY_C, YELLOW_D, GRAY_C])
        posterior = BarChart(values=[1, 4, 2], bar_names=["A", "B", "C"], y_range=[0, 5, 1], y_length=2.5, x_length=2.2, bar_colors=[TEAL_D, GREEN_D, TEAL_D])
        charts = VGroup(prior, evidence, posterior).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.75).shift(DOWN * 0.05)
        labels = VGroup(Text("prior", font_size=24), Text("evidence", font_size=24), Text("posterior", font_size=24)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1.45).next_to(charts, UP, buff=0.18)
        arrows = VGroup(Arrow(prior.get_right(), evidence.get_left(), buff=0.15), Arrow(evidence.get_right(), posterior.get_left(), buff=0.15))
        focus = SurroundingRectangle(posterior.bars[1], color=YELLOW_D, buff=0.06)
        caption_a = Text("Start with equal belief across three hypotheses.", font_size=23, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_b = Text("Evidence makes hypothesis B more plausible.", font_size=23, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)
        formula = MathTex(r"posterior \propto prior \times evidence", font_size=30).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.22)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(formula), FadeIn(prior), FadeIn(labels[0]), FadeIn(caption_a), run_time=3)
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrows[0]), FadeIn(evidence), FadeIn(labels[1]), ReplacementTransform(caption_a, caption_b), run_time=4)
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrows[1]), FadeIn(posterior), FadeIn(labels[2]), Create(focus), run_time=4)
        self.wait(4)

from manim import *

class AttentionWeightedAverageMicro(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Attention builds a weighted average", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        weights = Matrix([["0.15", "0.70", "0.15"]]).scale(0.72).shift(UP * 1.2)
        values = VGroup(*[Matrix([[label], [value]]).scale(0.55) for label, value in [("v_1", "cat"), ("v_2", "purr"), ("v_3", "tail")]]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.75).shift(DOWN * 0.45)
        weight_label = Text("attention weights", font_size=22, color=GRAY_B).next_to(weights, UP, buff=0.15)
        value_label = Text("value vectors", font_size=22, color=GRAY_B).next_to(values, DOWN, buff=0.18)
        strong_box = SurroundingRectangle(weights.get_columns()[1], color=YELLOW_D, buff=0.08)
        value_box = SurroundingRectangle(values[1], color=YELLOW_D, buff=0.1)
        output = VGroup(RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.08, width=1.6, height=0.75, color=GREEN_D, fill_color=GREEN_E, fill_opacity=0.25), MathTex("out", font_size=34, color=GREEN_D)).arrange().to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.75).shift(UP * 0.2)
        arrow = Arrow(values[1].get_right(), output.get_left(), buff=0.18, color=GREEN_D)
        legend = Text("larger weight means more influence", font_size=23, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(weights), FadeIn(weight_label), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(values), FadeIn(value_label), run_time=3)
        self.play(Create(strong_box), Create(value_box), run_time=2)
        self.play(TransformFromCopy(values[1], output), GrowArrow(arrow), FadeIn(legend), run_time=4)
        self.wait(3)

from manim import *

class ConfidenceIntervalBand(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Confidence interval = estimate plus uncertainty", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 10, 1], length=8.5, include_numbers=True).shift(UP * 0.65)
        estimate = Dot(line.n2p(5), color=YELLOW_D, radius=0.09)
        estimate_label = Text("estimate", font_size=24, color=YELLOW_D).next_to(estimate, UP, buff=0.3)
        def interval(left, right, color):
            width = abs(line.n2p(right)[0] - line.n2p(left)[0])
            rect = Rectangle(width=width, height=0.42, stroke_color=color, fill_color=color, fill_opacity=0.2)
            return rect.move_to((line.n2p(left) + line.n2p(right)) / 2)
        narrow = interval(4.4, 5.6, TEAL_D)
        wide = interval(3.3, 6.7, BLUE_D)
        narrow_brace = BraceBetweenPoints(line.n2p(4.4), line.n2p(5.6), direction=DOWN, color=TEAL_D)
        wide_brace = BraceBetweenPoints(line.n2p(3.3), line.n2p(6.7), direction=DOWN, color=BLUE_D)
        narrow_label = Text("narrower", font_size=25, color=TEAL_D).next_to(narrow_brace, DOWN, buff=0.22)
        wide_label = Text("wider means more uncertainty", font_size=25, color=BLUE_B).next_to(wide_brace, DOWN, buff=0.22)
        caption = Text("The interval is a range of plausible values, not a second estimate.", font_size=23, color=WHITE).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(line), FadeIn(estimate), FadeIn(estimate_label), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(narrow), Create(narrow_brace), FadeIn(narrow_label), run_time=3)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(narrow, wide), ReplacementTransform(narrow_brace, wide_brace), ReplacementTransform(narrow_label, wide_label), run_time=4)
        self.play(FadeIn(caption), run_time=2)
        self.wait(3)
